text: Lesson 69.
The car race.
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
zh: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。
zh_hant: 聽錄音，然後回答這個問題。

text: Which car was the winner in 1995?
There is a car race near our town every year.
zh: 每年我们镇附近都会举行一场汽车比赛。
zh_hant: 每年我們鎮附近都會舉行一場汽車比賽。

text: In 1995, there was a very big
race.
There were hundreds of people there.
My wife and I were at the race.
zh: 我和妻子都去了比赛现场。
zh_hant: 我和妻子都去了比賽現場。

text: Our friends Julie and Jack were there, too.
zh: 我们的朋友朱莉和杰克也在那里。
zh_hant: 我們的朋友朱莉和傑克也在那裡。

text: You can see us in the crowd.
zh: 你可以在人群中看到我们。
zh_hant: 你可以在人群中看到我們。

text: We are standing on the left.
There were twenty cars in the race.
There were English cars, French cars,
German cars, Italian cars,
American cars and Japanese cars.
It was an exciting finish.
zh: 那是一个激动人心的终点。
zh_hant: 那是一個激動人心的終點。

text: The winner was Billy Stewart.
He was in car number fifteen.
Five other cars were just behind him.
zh: 另外五辆车紧跟在他后面。
zh_hant: 另外五輛車緊跟在他後面。

text: On the way home, my wife said to me,
zh: 在回家的路上，我妻子对我说：
zh_hant: 在回家的路上，我妻子對我說：

text: 'Don't drive so quickly!
You're not Billy Stewart!'
zh: 你又不是比利·斯图尔特！'
zh_hant: 你又不是比利·斯圖爾特！'
